lens: The absence of curated empirical data precludes the formulation of specific, testable theses; the strategy must pivot to identifying critical data gaps where chaperone functions intersect with underexplored disease mechanisms or therapeutic interventions.
known_to_ignore: Chaperones facilitate protein folding and prevent aggregation
Proteostasis decline is associated with aging and neurodegenerative diseases
tensions: Alpha hint indicates proteostasis modules are not activated in Alzheimer's disease models but in other genetic contexts, suggesting model-specific dysregulation that challenges general AD pathology assumptions
gaps: Quantitative data on the impact of T_ex-PSR-associated chaperone disruption in CD8+ T cells on immunotherapy efficacy in human cohorts
Dose-response studies for HSP90 family inhibitors as senolytics across different human tissue types and ages
reviewer_objections: Without any cited evidence facts, the proposed framings lack empirical support, making any thesis non-reproducible and unsuitable for publication
next_extractions: Extract data on chaperone roles in T cell exhaustion and immunotherapy from preclinical models (inspired by doi:10.1038/s41586-025-09539-1)
Gather evidence on HSP90 inhibitor senolytic mechanisms in mouse vs. human cells (inspired by doi:10.1038/s41467-017-00314-z)
